lede: The most consequential meeting this week is Wednesday's joint work session where the Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and deep geothermal operations — the kind of shaping session that determines what actually gets built into county rules before any public vote. That same evening, commissioners head to Norwood for a rare West End appearance, taking up a Planning Commission seat appointment and hearing results from the Placerville Fire Survey. The Ecology Commission is also meeting Wednesday to dig into the 2022 Climate Action Plan's transportation and materials sections.

notable.stake: Commissioners may appoint a Planning Commission alternate; Placerville Fire Survey results presented.
Land Use Code amendments to forestry, oil and gas, geothermal, and condo plat rules being shaped now.
